Question: Get orders with customer names
Expected SQL: SELECT o.orderNumber, o.orderDate, c.customerName FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customerNumber = c.customerNumber;
Generated SQL: SELECT orders.*, customers.customerName FROM orders JOIN customers ON orders."customerNumber" = customers."customerNumber";

Question: Get employees with office city
Expected SQL: SELECT e.firstName, e.lastName, o.city FROM employees e JOIN offices o ON e.officeCode = o.officeCode;
Generated SQL: SELECT employeeNumber, firstName || ' ' || lastName AS name, city FROM employees JOIN offices ON employees.officeCode = offices.officeCode;

Question: Get payments with customer names
Expected SQL: SELECT c.customerName, p.amount, p.paymentDate FROM payments p JOIN customers c ON p.customerNumber = c.customerNumber;
Generated SQL: SELECT payments.*, customers.customerName FROM payments JOIN customers ON payments."customerNumber" = customers."customerNumber";

Question: Get order details with product names
Expected SQL: SELECT od.orderNumber, p.productName, od.quantityOrdered, od.priceEach FROM orderdetails od JOIN products p ON od.productCode = p.productCode;
Generated SQL: SELECT od."orderNumber", od."productCode", od."quantityOrdered", od."priceEach", p."productName" FROM orderdetails od JOIN products p ON od."productCode" = p."productCode";

Question: Get products with product line description
Expected SQL: SELECT p.productName, pl.textDescription FROM products p JOIN productlines pl ON p.productLine = pl.productLine;

Question: Get customers with sales rep names
Expected SQL: SELECT c.customerName, e.firstName, e.lastName FROM customers c JOIN employees e ON c.salesRepEmployeeNumber = e.employeeNumber;
Generated SQL: SELECT c."customerName", e."firstName" || ' ' || e."lastName" AS repName FROM customers c LEFT JOIN employees e ON c."salesRepEmployeeNumber" = e."employeeNumber";

Question: Get orders with customer city
Expected SQL: SELECT o.orderNumber, o.orderDate, c.city FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customerNumber = c.customerNumber;
Generated SQL: SELECT o.*, c.city FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o."customerNumber" = c."customerNumber";

Question: Get employees and their manager
Expected SQL: SELECT e.firstName AS employee_first, e.lastName AS employee_last, m.firstName AS manager_first, m.lastName AS manager_last FROM employees e LEFT JOIN employees m ON e.reportsTo = m.employeeNumber;

Question: Get orderdetails with product vendor
Expected SQL: SELECT od.orderNumber, p.productVendor, od.quantityOrdered FROM orderdetails od JOIN products p ON od.productCode = p.productCode;

Question: Get payments with customer country
Expected SQL: SELECT c.customerName, c.country, p.amount FROM payments p JOIN customers c ON p.customerNumber = c.customerNumber;
Generated SQL: SELECT payments.*, customers.country FROM payments JOIN customers ON payments."customerNumber" = customers."customerNumber";

Question: Count customers per country
Expected SQL: SELECT country, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers GROUP BY country ORDER BY customer_count DESC;
Generated SQL: SELECT country, COUNT(*) AS customercount FROM customers GROUP BY country ORDER BY country;

Question: Total payments per customer
Expected SQL: SELECT c.customerName, SUM(p.amount) AS total_payments FROM payments p JOIN customers c ON p.customerNumber = c.customerNumber GROUP BY c.customerName ORDER BY total_payments DESC;
Generated SQL: SELECT payments."customerNumber", SUM(payments.amount) AS total_payment FROM payments JOIN customers ON payments."customerNumber" = customers."customerNumber" GROUP BY payments."customerNumber";

Question: Number of orders per status
Expected SQL: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY status;
Generated SQL: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY status;

Question: Products per product line
Expected SQL: SELECT productLine, COUNT(*) AS product_count FROM products GROUP BY productLine;
Generated SQL: SELECT productlines.productLine, COUNT(products.productCode) AS product_count FROM products JOIN productlines ON products."productLine" = productlines.productLine GROUP BY productlines.productLine;

Question: Employees per office
Expected SQL: SELECT o.city, COUNT(e.employeeNumber) AS employee_count FROM employees e JOIN offices o ON e.officeCode = o.officeCode GROUP BY o.city;
Generated SQL: SELECT o.officeCode, o.city, COUNT(e.employeeNumber) AS employee_count FROM offices o LEFT JOIN employees e ON e.officeCode = o.officeCode GROUP BY o.officeCode, o.city;

Question: Total stock per product vendor
Expected SQL: SELECT productVendor, SUM(quantityInStock) AS total_stock FROM products GROUP BY productVendor ORDER BY total_stock DESC;
Generated SQL: SELECT "productVendor" AS vendor_name, SUM("quantityInStock") AS total_stock FROM products GROUP BY "productVendor"

Question: Average buy price per product line
Expected SQL: SELECT productLine, ROUND(AVG(buyPrice), 2) AS avg_buy_price FROM products GROUP BY productLine;

Question: Orders per customer
Expected SQL: SELECT c.customerName, COUNT(o.orderNumber) AS order_count FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customerNumber = c.customerNumber GROUP BY c.customerName ORDER BY order_count DESC;
Generated SQL: SELECT c.customerNumber AS customer_id, COUNT(o.orderNumber) AS order_count FROM customers c LEFT JOIN orders o ON o."customerNumber" = c."customerNumber" GROUP BY c.customerNumber ORDER BY c.customerNumber;

Question: Max MSRP per product line
Expected SQL: SELECT productLine, MAX(MSRP) AS max_MSRP FROM products GROUP BY productLine;
Generated SQL: SELECT p."productLine", MAX(p."MSRP") AS MaxMSRP FROM products p GROUP BY p."productLine";

Question: Min buy price per vendor
Expected SQL: SELECT productVendor, MIN(buyPrice) AS min_buy_price FROM products GROUP BY productVendor;
Generated SQL: SELECT "productVendor", MIN("buyPrice") AS min_price FROM products GROUP BY "productVendor";
